import board
import digitalio
import time

button = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.D5)
button.direction = digitalio.Direction.INPUT
button.pull = digitalio.Pull.UP

encoder = rotaryio.IncrementalEncoder(board.D6, board.D9)

button_state = None
last_position = encoder.position

while True:
    current_position = encoder.position
    print(current_position)
    last_position = current_position
    if not button.value and button_state is None:
        button_state = "pressed"
    if button.value and button_state == "pressed":
        print("Button pressed.")
        button_state = None
    time.sleep(0.05)","language":"python","showLineNumbers":false},"id":"3fb42376-46d0-4d9e-a993-ce5853385a0b"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"h","level":2,"children":[{"text":"Weiterführende Links"}]},{"type":"unordered-list","children":[{"type":"list-item","children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":""},{"type":"a","href":"https://learn.adafruit.com/rotary-encoder/circuitpython","children":[{"text":"https://learn.adafruit.com/rotary-encoder/circuitpython"}]},{"text":""}]}]}]}],"id":"0150c41d-53c6-4798-9327-583bc99f7d4e"}],"id":"f12e8557-9668-4766-ac3f-e04a93192b8d"},"exercises":[],"exerciseFolder":{"id":"","title":""},"relatedContent":{"articles":[{"id":"136534","title":"Umweltsensor auslesen"},{"id":"136568","title":"Analoge Sensoren"},{"id":"136570","title":"Servo-Motor ansteuern"},{"id":"136574","title":"LED-Matrix ansteuern"},{"id":"138604","title":"Einfache digitale Sensoren"}],"courses":[],"videos":[]},"sources":[]},"id":"c8c2845a-d8bd-4db6-b6de-2860febb96db"}}
